title: Mean fasting glucose by dinner group, vertical axis starting at 135 mg/dL
alt: Two bars for mean fasting glucose, 137.5 and 146.5 mg/dL, on an axis starting at 135, so the later-dinner bar looks about four times as tall.
longDescription: Two bars show the mean next-morning fasting glucose of the two dinner groups: 137.5 mg/dL for the 30 people who ate earlier and 146.5 mg/dL for the 30 who ate later, a difference of 9.0 mg/dL. The vertical axis starts at 135 mg/dL rather than at zero, so each bar shows only the part of the mean above 135. The drawn heights are therefore 2.5 and 11.5 units, and the later-dinner bar looks roughly four and a half times the earlier-dinner bar. The underlying means differ by about 6.5 percent. The bar heights on this chart do not stand in the same ratio as the quantities they represent.
